about.title: Not for everyone.
about.body: Husnah Luxe Collection is a small, deliberate edit of fragrance, scarves and everyday luxury. We choose pieces that are easy to wear, easy to gift and easy to come back to — then keep the edit tight enough that everything has a reason to be here.
about.secondary: Made for the ones who dress for themselves, move at their own pace, and know that the last detail is rarely an afterthought.

trust.title: Delivered across Nigeria, confirmed on WhatsApp.
trust.body: Choose your piece, send your order, and we’ll confirm availability, delivery and payment details with you directly. No accounts, no card forms, no bots.

contact.title: The fastest way to get an answer is a message.
contact.body: Questions about a scent, a scarf, a gift or delivery? Send us a note on WhatsApp. For everything else, call or email.
